- A1. Benign Opening - "Initiates conversation through greetings, politeness, or harmless introductory statements."
- A2. Educational Framing - "Frames a request as educational, course-related, academic, research-related, or learning-oriented. This includes normal course questions and educational framing around potentially sensitive requests."

The student is saying "Thank you for coming to office hours" which is polite/greeting, and "Can you ask me a question?" which is setting up an educational interaction. 

This seems most like A2. Educational Framing because it's clearly framed within an academic context (office hours) and is about learning/educational interaction. The student is asking to be quizzed or engaged in an educational way.

A1 (Benign Opening) is more about just greetings without any educational context. This turn has both politeness AND educational framing embedded in an academic setting.

I'll go with A2. Educational Framing.
